subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from gateway `config.patch`?
rationale: The source problem is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may broaden the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, which needs maintainer product/security intent before implementation.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only reduce scary exec wording
options.body: Keep Feishu boolean-only and make benign non-zero command status less alarming, but users still cannot keep streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Add `channels.feishu.streaming` to the gateway mutation allowlist so agents can disable streaming, but this broadens operator-controlled config writes and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu Card Kit streaming path and boolean streaming config that this decision would extend.
